scripts.dev: vp run build:packages && vp run --parallel --log labeled --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" dev
scripts.build: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker build
scripts.generate: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker generate
scripts.type-check: vp run build:packages && vp run --log grouped --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" type-check
scripts.test:unit: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/extension build && vp run --log grouped --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" test:unit && vp test run --project anti-slop
scripts.test:e2e: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:db: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:e2e:db
scripts.test:e2e:ui: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:e2e:ui
scripts.test:e2e:dev: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:e2e:dev
scripts.test:nuxt: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:nuxt
scripts.test:coverage: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/time-tracker test:coverage
scripts.test:extension: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/extension build && vp run --filter @osi/extension test:unit && vp run --filter @osi/extension test:browser
scripts.package:check: vp run build:packages && vp run --log grouped --filter "./packages/*" type-check && vp run --log grouped --filter "./packages/*" test:unit
scripts.trackers:seed: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter @osi/dev-seed seed
